scope: reused correlated development data; diagnostic associations, not causal attribution or an independent holdout

firstAction.boundary: last action in initial active packet, including recorded reactions
firstAction.note: 32 sampled paths are a diagnostic envelope, not an exhaustive probability bound. Replay packet boundaries and model action boundaries may differ.

observedShieldDiagnostic.boundary: last action in initial active packet, including recorded reactions
observedShieldDiagnostic.note: 32 sampled paths are a diagnostic envelope, not an exhaustive probability bound. Replay packet boundaries and model action boundaries may differ.

limitations: Observed shields are comparison-only diagnostic inputs, never inferred rings or production prediction inputs.
A 32-path envelope is not a probability bound. First replay packet and model reaction boundaries can differ.
High model frequency is not calibrated real-game win probability. Wrong model assumptions can produce repeatable wrong forecasts.
Shield discrepancies also occur among correct forecasts; they do not establish equipment as the sole or dominant cause.
